#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=lammps_simulation
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=64
#SBATCH --constraint=hpc7g.6xlarge
#SBATCH --cpu-bind=cores

# This is a common requirement on HPC clusters to load the necessary environment.
# The specific module may differ based on the cluster's setup.
# You might need to change 'openmpi' to your cluster's MPI provider to use the EFA.
module load openmpi

# Execute the LAMMPS simulation using srun. 
# The --cpu-bind option ensures tasks are pinned to specific CPU cores for better performance.
srun lmp -v x 20 -v y 20 -v z 20 -in in.reaxff.hns
```
